title: Task Map picks: 12px text floor and a Filters button on narrow windows
head: t115-taskmap-picks
body:
Braden's Task Map picks (2026-10-12), on top of #86.

## What
- Task Map text never shrinks below **12px** on screen (`TASK_MAP_MIN_TEXT_PX` 11 → 12). Zoom to fit and zoom-out stop there; the map scrolls instead.
- On narrow windows (below 900px) the filter form folds behind a **Filters** button (shows `Filters · n` when filters are set; aria-expanded/controls; Enter/Space toggle, Escape returns focus). Wide windows unchanged. Toggling never changes or applies filters.
- Selecting a task with the detail panel open keeps the 2-column map (Braden's pick; already the behavior from #86).

docs/design/task-map/picks/: tasks-map-narrow (380px, light/dark), tasks-map-zoom (60 tasks, 1280), tasks-map-focus (1280) — light and dark.
